{{Top|leg}}
'''Arrgrar vines''' were plants on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. [[Color/Legends|Yellow]] in color, the arrgrar strands grew very quickly out of decaying planet material. The vines spread by the action of underbrush-dwelling rodents who spread its spores. When the vines began to grow, they inserted tendrils into other plants and sucked nutrients and water out of their host. The [[Death/Legends|dying]] host plant slowly turned yellow, and once its nutrients were exhausted, the arrgrar vine died too.

The yellow of the arrgrar vine was one color used in the [[Tarasin]] [[Tarasin Skintone Language|skintone language]].
